preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1 for a valid tree.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n numbers, one for each vertex.
Each dominant index must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.split()[i]) <= max_depth for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each dominant index must not exceed the maximum depth of the tree.
